propositions: The runaway guard sits outermost and counts memo-served (cached) file-read repeats as loop evidence before the memo layer handles them, causing the guard to trip despite lever-2 memoization making repeats cheap
Reads past the cached window fall back to uncached exact-range reads, degrading the distinct-ratio further and triggering false RunawayToolLoopError aborts on legitimate completion-verification runs
The guard must observe only EXECUTED tool calls (cache misses), not memo-served repeats, to avoid fighting the memoization layer and falsely aborting legitimate closes

A shared ToolCallLedger tracks observed vs executed calls and a served-streak, allowing the guard's ratio arm to compute distinctness over executed work only while a backstop arm bounds pure cache-served loops after a full window of zero execution
The completion-policy layer sits between guard and memo in composition order and must keep seeing all calls, so guard and memo must coordinate via the ledger instead of reordering
